description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity for an Android TV application. It sets up a simple user interface with a 'Hello World' message, ensures focus handling for TV remote navigation, and manages key events such as 'enter' and 'back'.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity of the Android TV app, responsible for setting up the UI and handling remote key events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures focus and display text.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key presses from the TV remote, providing functionality for center/enter, back, and passing other events to the superclass.
